candidates.term: The General inside the Hour Gate
candidates.defline: The General lives inside your Hour Gate: the root of your harvest is strength, held to the last.
candidates.reading: This position rules Health, Family, and Growth, and it works in the root of your late years. The General lives inside your Hour Gate: discipline never quite retires in you, and the last chapters keep a garrison quality, routines held, standards kept, one more campaign than you planned. Family feels your protection more than your softness, and they rely on both. The body in late life responds to training like an old soldier, gratefully and fast. March daily, rest like an order, and keep a gate open for visitors. Fortresses age best with gardens.
candidates.teaser: The root of your late years is discipline that never quite retires. Expect standing, respect, and one more campaign than you planned. Keep a gate for rest.

domain_readings.Health: Your late body responds to training like an old soldier, gratefully and fast: strength returns on demand, stiffness arrives through pride. March daily, stretch nightly, rest like an order. Managed this way, the constitution outlasts every prediction made about it.
domain_readings.Family: Your late family lives inside your protection: they feel the perimeter more than the embrace, and both are love. Let the walls show their doors. The household that knows it is guarded and knows it is cherished gives you the finest last years available.
domain_readings.Growth: Discipline never quite retires in you, and late growth rides it: new practices, kept standards, one more campaign than planned. The root stays strong through use. Keep a gate open for rest and visitors. Fortresses age best with gardens.

candidates.life_chapter: Your late chapter holds the garrison: routines kept, standards held, protection running silently under everything. Expect stronger last decades than most, carried by discipline that forgot how to stop. Add the garden to the fortress. It is the one structure still missing.
candidates.relations: The protected are this seat’s people: family and dependents living safely inside arrangements they rarely see. Your care is architectural. Show the blueprints occasionally, and the gratitude finds its address. Guarded love wants naming too.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the garrison understaffs: discipline available, structure unbuilt. Set the daily drill this month. The root grows on routine.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, the fortress admits no weather: spontaneity processed at the gate. Leave one day a week unplanned.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, protection becomes confinement: loved ones safe, slightly imprisoned.
candidates.health_line: Your late vitality is drill-shaped: it thrives on kept routines and erodes in formless days. Keep the morning ritual sacred, whatever it is.
